# Godot VFX

Target: Godot 4.7.2.stable, macOS Apple Silicon.

Expert level here means effects built as layers of small systems, every silent particle failure
caught by a script before anyone looks, and every claim about look or cost backed by frames captured
at exact times and by measured overdraw and GPU time per renderer. The agent builds effects in code,
renders them windowed, and looks at contact sheets. If a sibling skill named here is missing from
your available skills, ask the user to install it
(`npx skills add scenario-labs/skills --skill <name>`); unattended, proceed from tool schemas and
flag the gap.

**REQUIRED BACKGROUND:** scenario-godot-expert (gd_env, gd_run, gd_review, AgentKit, GD_MAX slots,
windowed vs headless).

## Stance (the expert delta)

1. **An effect is layers, and the head of a projectile is not particles.** A projectile is head,
   tail and sparks; the head is a shader mesh with scrolling noise and HDR color above 1 (Le Lu
   74XywaLGO5Q 00:00:34, 00:08:05). An explosion is flash, fire, smoke, sparks, debris, shockwave
   and light, each a small system made by duplicating a working one and changing a few values
   (Brackeys htRjt505sPg 00:02:30, 00:13:27). A one-particle system is fine for a shockwave ring
   (00:18:02).
2. **Particle settings fail silently, so audit them in code.** Color and alpha curves do nothing
   without `vertex_color_use_as_albedo`; scale curves do nothing on a particle billboard without
   `billboard_keep_scale`; trails need `trail_enabled`, a Ribbon or Tube trail mesh and
   `use_particle_trails` (Godotneers cZ5Ang_Ji8E 00:09:44, 00:32:54; Brackeys 00:23:44). A
   sub-emitter's own `amount` is a global cap (Godotneers yKoGuBGZatY 00:44:48) and its AABB is not
   inherited (cZ5Ang_Ji8E 01:06:19). [`vfx_audit.gd`](scripts/agentkit/vfx/vfx_audit.gd) flags all
   of these.
3. **`visibility_aabb` is both culling and the collision area** (Godotneers cZ5Ang_Ji8E 00:45:28).
   Measure it rather than guessing: on 4.7.2, `capture_aabb()` pads particle positions by the draw
   mesh's longest axis and ignores per-particle scale (measured: Flash quad 2 m gave a 4 m box; a
   ring scaled to 4.5 m still gave 2 m) [added]. `fit_aabb` corrects for scale and must run inside
   the level, because debris without its colliders falls 8 m through the world.
4. **Tier by renderer, never by `amount_ratio`.** `amount_ratio` hides particles and saves nothing
   (GPUParticles3D docs; Bonkahe BUa-mKHEPUM 00:01:18). Lower `amount` per tier and drop the layers
   the renderer cannot draw. Compatibility drops decals with no warning, and logs warnings for
   trails and sub-emitters (measured) [added].
5. **Particles do not touch physics.** Gameplay hits come from a ray swept every physics tick;
   particle collision needs GPUParticlesCollision nodes, and the step per tick is speed / fixed_fps,
   with fixed_fps 30 by default (Godotneers cZ5Ang_Ji8E 00:44:23, 00:47:17).
6. **Juice is code you can test.** Hit-stop lowers `Engine.time_scale` and waits on a timer that
   ignores it, then restores 1.0 (Mostly Mad Jwv9t5zFlqI 00:00:32, 00:01:37). Shake comes from
   smooth noise with decay (Mostly Mad pG4KGyxQp40 00:00:39); trauma squared and a 3D camera offset
   are [added].
7. **Judge frames, not the inspector.** Render windowed with `--fixed-fps 60`, so frame k is t =
   k/60 s, at 0.03 to 2.2 s, and look at one contact sheet per renderer. Overdraw comes from
   `DEBUG_DRAW_OVERDRAW` with a measured per-layer calibration, and GPU time from the Vulkan driver
   (Metal reports 0 on macOS) [added].
8. **A trail that follows a node is a particle shader trick.** Pin the particle to
   `EMISSION_TRANSFORM[3].xyz` in `start()` and `process()`, with no forces (Octodemy iPCzOe-S9EQ
   00:05:42).

## Establish first

| Input                            | Changes                                                             | Default                                                        |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Target renderers                 | which layers exist (trails, decals, sub-emitters)                   | Forward+ desktop, Mobile phones, Compatibility web             |
| 2D or 3D                         | node family, collision (LightOccluder2D vs GPUParticlesCollision3D) | 3D                                                             |
| Camera distance and screen share | quad sizes, overdraw budget                                         | gameplay camera 4 to 10 m                                      |
| Frame budget for VFX             | amounts per tier                                                    | under 2.5 ms GPU for six bursts at 720p on the dev Mac [added] |
| Look                             | unshaded additive vs lit smoke (Le Lu e_6ZA-xa_DQ 00:07:23)         | stylized, unshaded fire, alpha-blended smoke                   |
| Spawning model                   | free-on-done vs pooled                                              | fx_burst frees itself; `done` signal for pools                 |

## Workflow

1. **Project and kit.** Clone Base3D, `gd_vfx.install(P)` copies tooling to `addons/agentkit/vfx/`,
   and shaders and runtime scripts to `res://vfx/` (they ship with the game). Read `project.godot`.
   GATE: `3d/physics_engine="Jolt Physics"` and the intended `renderer/rendering_method` are present
   as text; `vfx_selftest.gd:compile` reports 0 errors over 10 scripts (`check_all` skips
   `addons/agentkit/`).
2. **Build per tier in code.** `gd_vfx.build(P, "high"|"mobile"|"low")` saves `explosion_`,
   `impact_`, `fireball_`, `shot_` and `burst_stage_<tier>.tscn` from
   [`vfx_recipes.gd`](scripts/agentkit/vfx/vfx_recipes.gd). Specs are dictionaries (`VB.emitter`);
   curves and ramps become CurveTexture and GradientTexture1D (HDR when a channel exceeds 1); shared
   textures live in `res://vfx/tex/*.tres` (Brackeys 00:15:04: never embed). GATE: build ok, no
   captured errors. Kit layers: **fireball** (stretched SphereMesh head with `fx_fire_head`, noise
   minus gradient, HDR; inverted-Fresnel `fx_soft_core`; world-space eroded puffs driven by
   `INSTANCE_CUSTOM.y`, onetupthree N9ilhL8JFes 00:05:38; velocity sparks; ribbon via
   `fx_trail_follow` and an OmniLight3D, both off on low); **explosion** (flash, fire, depth-sorted
   smoke, colliding sparks, Face-Y ring, debris with a 30 Hz smoke sub-emitter on high, light,
   scorch Decal except low); **fx_projectile** (ray swept every tick, impact on the hit normal,
   frees itself after its trail dies).
3. **Static audit.** `gd_vfx.audit(P, scene, tier, level)`. GATE: 0 errors for the matching tier.
   Warnings are read and either fixed or written down. Prove the audit catches problems once on
   `broken.tscn` (21 findings, 4 errors).
4. **Fit AABBs in context.**
   `gd_vfx.fit_aabb(P, "res://vfx/burst_stage_high.tscn", node="Explosion", play_method="Explosion:play", write=True, out=effect_scene)`.
   GATE: `old_encloses_live` true for every emitter, and the timeline `aabb_check` reports nothing
   outside.
5. **Look at it, per renderer.**
   `gd_vfx.timeline(P, scene, times=[0.03,0.1,0.2,0.35,0.6,1.0,1.5,2.2], renderer=..., trigger="none", extra={"play_method": "Explosion:play", "aabb_check": True})`;
   for the projectile, `extra={"hold": "Fireball"}`. Open the contact sheet. GATE: no all-black,
   all-white or uniform flags. By eye: the flash reads first, fire turns to smoke, nothing pops, the
   ring fades, sparks bounce on the floor, the scorch stays, and the head reads as fire with its
   tail behind it.
6. **Fallback.** For Compatibility, use the low tier (no ribbon, decal, light or sub-emitter), or
   `gd_vfx.to_cpu` for a CPUParticles3D twin. GATE: read the `lost` list (collision, sub-emitters,
   trails, particle shaders, alpha_curve baked into the ramp, align mode) and render the twin in
   `gl_compatibility`.
7. **Budget.** `gd_vfx.overdraw(...)` per tier, and
   `gd_run.profile_scene(stress scene, size=(1280,720), driver="vulkan")`. GATE: p99 layers and GPU
   p95 inside the numbers below, low tier lighter than high.
8. **Behavior.** Run [`vfx_selftest.gd`](scripts/agentkit/vfx/vfx_selftest.gd): `lifecycle` (node
   count back to baseline after 5 spawns), `projectile` (one hit, explosion spawned, everything
   freed) and `juice` (time_scale restored, shake bounded and back to 0). GATE: all ok.

## Expert checklist (state these in the plan)

- **Complete code in the deliverable**: paste the `vfx_recipes.gd` specs and
  [`fx_fire_head.gdshader`](scripts/agentkit/vfx/shaders/fx_fire_head.gdshader), not prose; readers
  may lack the kit.
- **Replay** with `restart()`, not `emitting = true` (docs).
- **Deterministic frames**: `use_fixed_seed`, then `speed_scale = 0`, `restart()`,
  `request_particles_process(t)`. Two seeks to 0.4 s were pixel-identical; without a fixed seed they
  differed by 0.50 (P13).
- **Fire into smoke in one system**: premultiplied blend (`BLEND_MODE_PREMULT_ALPHA`, texture
  imported with Premultiply Alpha): low alpha adds, high alpha mixes; fade with black and alpha 0
  (Brackeys 30:56 to 32:39). Measured over gray: alpha 0 brightened it, alpha 1 replaced it (P13).
- **Smoke LOD**: [`fx_smoke_lod.gdshader`](scripts/agentkit/vfx/shaders/fx_smoke_lod.gdshader) maps
  a black-to-white color ramp to mip 0 to 8 of one noise texture, so the puff diffuses almost free;
  color moves to a uniform (Le Lu e_6ZA-xa_DQ 16:40 to 24:20). Detail spread fell from 0.10 to 0.0
  over life on all three renderers (P13).
- **Duplicating a system**: Brackeys' "Make Unique Recursive, but never the texture" is
  `duplicate(true)` in 4.7.2: embedded curves become unique, external `.tres` textures stay shared
  (P13). Keep the mesh shared and the material in `material_override` (Brackeys 13:59 to 15:04).
- **Billboard plus direction**: Align Y conflicts with billboards; use `transform_align` Z
  Billboard + Y to Velocity (Brackeys 27:07).
- **Layered transparents flicker**: offset the nodes first, then `sorting_offset` (Brackeys 29:57).
- **TAA ghosting**: `DRAW_ORDER_INDEX` (the 3D default) is the only order with motion vectors; keep
  it for opaque particles (docs).
- **Preprocess** runs the shader `fixed_fps` times per preprocessed second and can stall the GPU;
  never on one-shots (docs, audit `preprocess_one_shot`).
- **Near-camera quads**: `distance_fade_mode` Pixel Alpha fades by distance without a depth read;
  proximity fade softens intersections.

## Quality gates

Measurable:

- Audit: 0 errors for the tier. Kit compile: 0 parse errors. Project file has Jolt and the chosen
  renderer.
- AABB: every emitter's live box inside `visibility_aabb` at every captured time.
- Lifecycle: node count equals the baseline after N spawns, and `done` fires N times with no safety
  timeouts.
- Projectile: one `hit` at the expected time (12 m at 14 m/s gives 0.867 s, frame 52) and nothing
  left in the tree.
- Juice: `Engine.time_scale` is 1.0 after single and overlapping stops, with no early restore; shake
  offset at most the maximum and exactly 0 at the end.
- Overdraw p99 and GPU p95 per tier against the table. Compatibility logs show the expected warnings
  and no unexpected ones.

Visual (contact sheets of at most 1600 px; rubric in
[`references/critique.md`](references/critique.md)): flash then fire then smoke, no popping,
readable silhouette at gameplay distance, ring fades, sparks bounce, the trail follows the head, the
explosion is oriented to the surface normal, and each tier holds up on its renderer.

## Common mistakes

| Mistake                                            | What it looks like                                                           | Fix                                                 |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| Vertex color off                                   | white quads, curves ignored                                                  | `vertex_color_use_as_albedo`                        |
| Keep scale off on a particle billboard             | scale curve ignored                                                          | `billboard_keep_scale`                              |
| Trail without `use_particle_trails`                | chopped flat pieces                                                          | set it on the trail mesh material                   |
| Child amount under the cap                         | sub-emitter trails thin out                                                  | `link_sub_emitter` computes the cap                 |
| Default 8 m AABB                                   | effect pops out, collisions stop                                             | `fit_aabb` in the level                             |
| `collision_base_size` larger than the spawn height | debris stuck at the origin (measured: 0.5 m of travel instead of 10 to 12 m) | spawn above the collider                            |
| `amount_ratio` used as the mobile tier             | no saving                                                                    | lower `amount`                                      |
| `emitting = true` to replay                        | one-shot sometimes skipped                                                   | `restart()` (docs)                                  |
| Freeing the projectile on hit                      | world-space trail vanishes at once                                           | stop emitters, wait for the trail to die, then free |
| `convert_from_particles` on view-depth sorting     | "Index p_order = 3 is out of bounds", sorting lost                           | `VB.to_cpu` maps draw order                         |
| Same colors on every renderer                      | smoke near black on Compatibility                                            | retune the low tier on Compatibility                |
| Profiling on Metal                                 | gpu_ms 0                                                                     | `driver="vulkan"`                                   |

## Handoffs

- **Receives** hit events (point, normal, pooling) from scenario-godot-gameplay, budgets from
  scenario-godot-performance-export, glow and environment from scenario-godot-rendering-lighting.
- **Delivers** `res://vfx/*.tscn` per tier, `res://vfx/shaders` and `runtime` (fx_burst,
  fx_projectile, Juice), audit JSON, sheets, overdraw and GPU tables.
- **Asks** scenario-godot-shaders for new surface shaders (dissolve, water, distortion),
  scenario-godot-audio for impact sounds, and scenario-godot-2d for 2D effect integration.

## Godot 4.7 notes

- `capture_aabb()` pads by the draw mesh's longest axis and ignores particle scale (4.7.2,
  measured).
- `CPUParticles3D.convert_from_particles` copies `draw_order` as a raw integer, but the enums
  differ: GPU view depth is 3, CPU view depth is 2. CPUParticles3D has no `alpha_curve` (4.7.2,
  measured).
- Compatibility logs "Particle trails are only available when using the Forward+ or Mobile renderer"
  and "does not support particle sub-emitters"; decals disappear with no warning.
- Headless draws nothing, so captures need a windowed run. On macOS, Metal reports GPU time as 0;
  use `--rendering-driver vulkan`.
- Curve enforces `min_value` and `max_value` since 4.4, so widen the range for scale curves above 1.
  AgX arrived in 4.4. Glow defaults changed in 4.6 (intensity 0.8 to 0.3): retune older effects.
- Particle shaders use `start()` and `process()`; a Godot 3 `vertex()` writing `VELOCITY` fails.
- The trail sections refresh bug (Octodemy, 4.7 era) and Godotneers' 4.2 trail and SDF bugs: not yet
  run on 4.7.2.

# Roblox animation and characters

Target line: Roblox Studio (October 2026 build) on macOS, driven through the scenario-roblox-expert
toolkit.

Expert level here means every clip, layer, IK chain and face is proven in Studio by numbers: which
track wins each joint, when each marker fires, what the server sees, and that the stepped pose
matches its source. An agent cannot drive the Animation Editor, so it builds clips in code, steps
them in Edit, plays them in a playtest and measures joints and tracks before it calls anything done.
If a sibling skill named here is missing from your available skills, ask the user to install it
(`npx skills add scenario-labs/skills --skill <name>`); unattended, proceed from tool schemas and
flag the gap.

**REQUIRED BACKGROUND:** scenario-roblox-expert (channels, review loop, toolkit, current-Roblox
traps).

## Stance (the expert delta)

1. **Avatar joints are `AnimationConstraint`, not `Motor6D`.** The Avatar Joint Upgrade made R15
   `C0` and `C1` read-only (L1, L8). Procedural motion multiplies into `Transform` in PreSimulation,
   which applies as a deferred batch and does not replicate (Suphi Kaner, BRYp2-rdpXQ 00:00:33).
   Code that looks joints up must accept both classes.
2. **Load through the `Animator`, from the side that owns the rig.** The owning client plays its
   character's tracks and the server sees them (L6); the server plays NPC tracks and clients see
   them (L7). `Humanoid:LoadAnimation` is deprecated.
3. **Priority partitions joints; keys claim them.** A higher priority wins only the joints it keys,
   and an identity key still claims its joint (L4). In clips built in code, parent Poses that are
   only on the path need Weight 0, or they override lower tracks [added] (L4).
4. **Time gameplay with markers, never waits.** Use one event name with a parameter (Develuper,
   d5GGIJJyMpg 00:02:52). `GetMarkerReachedSignal` fired within one frame (L6); `KeyframeReached`
   needs named keyframes (BrawlDev, zSK7bOoxuig 00:25:25).
5. **Faces play as clips, not property writes.** On a player's dynamic head, a `FaceControls` write
   or a finished tween reverts to 0 within 0.5 s, even with every track stopped [added] (L10, L16).
   A face clip holds, replicates, and survives the mood animation.
6. **IKControls are created on the server; look-at weight is 0.999.** At weight 1 the neck twists
   when the target passes behind; `IKControl.Priority` orders the solves; `Pole` is set from code
   (Suphi Kaner, 8fV-XOOj6O4 00:18:56, 00:53:00, 00:54:40).
7. **Blender clips are 24 fps, armature only, no scale keys.** Leaf bones, NLA strips and All
   Actions go off; Force Start/End Keying and Simplify 0 stay on (Mykaiju, NI7GXKLwk6U 00:23:45 to
   00:27:07). 60 fps doubles the keys for no gain in gameplay (Nisky, EM9u4gIHoRg 00:07:55).
8. **Temporary ids are test fixtures.** `RegisterKeyframeSequence` hashes and `active://` ids work
   in Studio only; the shipped game references published `rbxassetid://` ids owned by the experience
   owner (Animation Editor docs).

## Establish first

- **Rig kind.** R15 avatar (AnimationConstraint, BallSocket limits), custom part rig (Motor6D),
  skinned mesh (Bones), or AnimationController creature. Run P1 instead of guessing.
- **Who plays what.** Player clips on the client, NPC clips on the server, cosmetic layers locally.
- **Server Authority.** When on, an Animator keeps at most 8 active tracks, and tracks are looked up
  each tick with `GetTrackByAnimationId`, never cached.
- **Character Controller Library.** When on, movement comes from `ControllerManager` and abilities;
  ability callbacks never yield.
- **Faces.** Is there a dynamic head (`Head` has `FaceControls`)?
- **Motion source.** Blender FBX, a Scenario-generated rig or motion, the Animation Editor, or code.
- **Publishing owner.** User or group; clips must be published under the experience owner.
- Defaults: R15, Action for gameplay clips, Idle and Movement for locomotion, 24 fps, markers named
  after the event with a parameter.

## Procedure

Code for every step is in `references/procedures.md` (P1 to P15), with the test that ran it and its
numbers.

1. **Inspect the rig (P1).** Run `AnimRig.joints`, `AnimRig.tree` and `AnimRig.path` on the model.
   GATE: joint classes are known, every animated part has a path from the root, and an Animator
   exists.
2. **Build or bring the clips (P2, P3, P10).** Code clips use `AnimClip.keyframes` or
   `AnimClip.curves`, are registered with `AnimClip.register` and loaded with `AnimClip.load`, which
   waits for `Length > 0`. Blender clips go through `blender_roblox_anim.py` (audit, export, sample)
   and `AnimClip.fromSamples`. GATE: stepped joint angles match the keys within 0.3 degrees; Blender
   bone tails match within 0.01 studs.
3. **Layer and time (P4).** Set priorities, weights and fades; key only the joints each clip owns;
   put markers on contact frames. GATE: `AnimClip.tracks(animator)` shows the intended winner per
   joint, and each marker fires once per cycle.
4. **Preview in Edit (P5).** Call `AnimClip.settle` first: a clip that ended on its own still blends
   into the next one (P3). `rbx_animation.pose_sheet` steps a track with `Animator:StepAnimations`,
   captures each time and builds one contact sheet. GATE: read the sheet; the frame differences are
   above zero; `AnimRig.reset` leaves no posed joint before the place is saved.
5. **Playtest (P6, P8).** Play player clips from the client and NPC clips from the server; read the
   joints on both sides. GATE: the server finds the client's track, both sides report the same joint
   angle, and a capture shows the pose.
6. **Layers, IK and faces (P9, P12, P7).** Procedural offsets go into `Transform` in PreSimulation
   and skip when `Animator.EvaluationThrottled` is true. IK comes from `AnimIK.reach` and
   `AnimIK.lookAt`; faces from `AnimFace.clip`. GATE: the measured neck yaw, IK gap and face values
   on the server, plus a capture each.
7. **Defaults and audit (P13, P14).** Replace default animations through the `Animate` values; run
   `AnimAudit.all`. GATE: no error or warning finding; after a state change the client plays the new
   clip, checked by `Length` and joint angle, not by id.
8. **Publish list.** List every clip to publish, its priority, loop and markers, and the owner.
   GATE: no temporary id in shipped code (`AnimAudit` rule `temp-animation-id`).

| Stopped and Ended              | 500 and 816 ms for a 0.5 s playback                                              | L6                               |
| Natural end, then a new clip   | old pose blends in for 0.25 to 0.375 s (31.8 instead of 22.5 degrees at 0.25 s)  | L3                               |
| First load                     | Length 0 at `LoadAnimation`, 14 ms to load in Edit                               | L2                               |
| Neck layer of 45 degrees       | 41.9 degrees on the joint, head 45.5 degrees off the root                        | L8                               |
| IK reach                       | hand 0.20 to 0.23 studs from a reachable target within 0.1 s, same on the client | L9                               |
| IK limits                      | 4.17 studs from an unreachable target; 1.13 at Weight 0.5                        | L9                               |
| IK SmoothTime 0.5              | gap 1.81 to 0.37 studs over 0.6 s                                                | L9                               |
| Look-at                        | Weight 0.999; head within 0.05 degrees of the target                             | L9; Suphi Kaner                  |
| Face write or tween            | back to 0 within 0.5 s                                                           | L10                              |
| Face clip                      | JawDrop 0.55 on client and server; the open mouth shows in the capture           | L10                              |
| Blender to Studio              | worst bone-tail error 0.0002 studs, 10 bones, 25 frames                          | L12                              |
| Skin weights                   | at most 4 influences per vertex                                                  | skinning docs                    |
| Server Authority               | at most 8 active tracks per Animator                                             | Server Authority docs            |
| Dynamic head                   | 4,000 triangles; validation checks 5 animations from 17 FACS poses               | specs; Roblox Learn, OwhkWzSBnf0 |

## Quality gates

Measurable:

- `AnimAudit.all(game)` returns no error and no warning (P14).
- Every track the code plays reports `Length > 0`, the intended priority and `WeightCurrent` 1 at
  rest (`AnimClip.tracks`).
- Each marker the code listens to fires once per cycle at its time, within one frame.
- Server and client report the same joint angles for replicated tracks.
- Blender exports pass `audit` with no finding, and P10's tail error is under 0.01 studs.
- `AnimRig.dirty` is empty on every rig before the place is saved.

Visual (contact sheets of at most 1,600 px, `rbx_review.contact_sheet`):

- Pose sheet of each clip at 4 to 6 times: silhouettes read, arcs, no interpenetration, closed loop.
- Playtest captures: player clip, NPC clip, IK reach with the target visible, face close-up next to
  a neutral capture.
- Judge with `references/critique.md`.

## Common mistakes

| Mistake                                           | Symptom                                                                          | Fix                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Clip at Core or Idle                              | plays but the default idle wins                                                  | Action for gameplay clips                                                                 |
| Action clip keys the legs                         | legs freeze while walking                                                        | key only the joints the clip owns                                                         |
| Code-built clip with Weight 1 parents             | upper body overrides idle and walk                                               | Weight 0 on path-only Poses (`AnimClip.keyframes`)                                        |
| Playing right after a fresh register              | nothing moves, `Length` 0                                                        | `AnimClip.load` waits for `Length > 0`                                                    |
| `C0` writes on avatar joints                      | "Property is read only"                                                          | multiply into `Transform` in PreSimulation                                                |
| `FindFirstChildOfClass("Motor6D")` on R15         | nil on upgraded avatars                                                          | `AnimRig.joint` accepts both classes                                                      |
| Tweening `FaceControls`                           | expression flashes, then neutral                                                 | `AnimFace.clip` played on the Animator                                                    |
| `task.wait` for hit timing                        | hits drift with speed and lag                                                    | markers with parameters                                                                   |
| Preview left posed in Edit                        | saved place shows the pose                                                       | `AnimRig.reset(rig)`                                                                      |
| `rig.HumanoidRootPart` on a Custom skinned import | nil: the importer names the root `RootPart` (2 x 2 x 1), and bones never collide | `AnimRig.prepareImport`; clips authored before it still bind (`references/characters.md`) |
| Measuring right after another clip ended          | first 0.3 s blends toward the old end pose                                       | `AnimClip.settle` in Edit; deliberate fades in game                                       |
| Checking a replaced default by its id             | id matches while the old clip plays                                              | check `Length` and the joint after a state change                                         |
| 60 fps or scale keys in Blender                   | heavy clips, scale ignored                                                       | 24 fps, rotation and location only                                                        |
| LookAt Weight 1                                   | neck twists when the target is behind                                            | 0.999                                                                                     |
| Shipping a temporary id                           | works in Studio, fails live                                                      | publish under the experience owner                                                        |
| Animator created on a client for a shared rig     | others never see it                                                              | create it on the server                                                                   |

## Handoffs

- **Receives from scenario-roblox-assets:** imported rigs and skinned meshes, including rigged
  characters and motions generated by scenario-3d. Motions arrive as FBX or Blender files and go
  through P10; rigs arrive as Models that P1 inspects.
- **Delivers to scenario-roblox-gameplay:** clips with markers at contact frames and their
  parameters; gameplay owns the hitboxes, state and NPC behavior that call them.
- **Delivers to scenario-roblox-vfx-audio:** marker names and times for footsteps, impacts and
  trails.
- **Works with scenario-roblox-networking:** look direction replication, Server Authority track
  rules, client-only cosmetic layers.
- **Works with scenario-roblox-performance:** Animator counts, NPC culling (anchor and disable
  Animators out of range, RDC 2025 rwLEnBtXr30 00:09:24), `stepAnimation` cost.
- **Works with scenario-roblox-architecture:** where animation controllers live (client modules for
  player characters, server services for NPCs).
- **Asks the user** to publish the listed clips; agents never upload.

## Current Roblox notes

- Avatar Joint Upgrade: R15 avatars spawn with 15 AnimationConstraint joints and 14
  BallSocketConstraints (L1).
- `Workspace.AuthorityMode` is not readable from plugin-level Luau (RobloxScript capability): ask
  the user whether Server Authority is on.
- Character Controller Library is opt-in. With it off, `require("@rbx/AvatarAbilities")` never
  returns on the client and returns a table on the server (L15).
- Adaptive Animation: `HumanoidRigDescription:AutoRig` needs RobloxScript capability; joint mapping
  and T-pose are set in the Adaptive Animation tool (GUI). Mapping joints from code did not retarget
  a clip onto renamed parts (L14).
- `AnimationGraphDefinition` exists; graphs are edited in the Graph Editor (GUI).
- The Animation Editor opens from Avatar > Clip Editor in the current UI.

## References

- [`references/procedures.md`](references/procedures.md): P1 to P15 with full code, test ids and
  results.
- [`references/characters.md`](references/characters.md): Custom skinned import to a rig, player and
  NPC playback scripts, creature foot planting, dynamic head cages and validation, FBX import

- [`references/expert-notes.md`](references/expert-notes.md): principles by expert, with timestamps.
- [`references/critique.md`](references/critique.md): the rubric for judging animation work.
- [`references/gui-paths.md`](references/gui-paths.md): Animation Editor, import, faces and beta

- [`references/sources.md`](references/sources.md): every source with credentials and timestamps.
- [`scripts/rbx_animation.py`](scripts/rbx_animation.py): kit inlining, Blender wrapper, sample
  loader, Edit pose sheets.
- [`scripts/blender_roblox_anim.py`](scripts/blender_roblox_anim.py): headless Blender test rig,
  audit, FBX export, re-import and samples.
- [`scripts/agentkit/animation/`](scripts/agentkit/animation/): AnimRig, AnimClip, AnimAudit, AnimIK
  and AnimFace Luau modules.

# Roblox architecture (gameplay programmer and architect)

Target: Roblox Studio (October 2026 build) on macOS, driven through the scenario-roblox-expert
toolkit.

Expert architecture on Roblox means placement and RunContext decide what runs where, one entry
script per side boots every module in two phases, server modules own the truth that attributes
mirror, and tags bind behavior to instances with an owner for every connection. This skill carries
those rules from the sources, corrected by live tests in Studio 0.743, plus a tested arena core
(round loop, teams, maps, HUD, shop, sword) and the tools that build and audit it. If a sibling
skill named here is missing from your available skills, ask the user to install it
(`npx skills add scenario-labs/skills --skill <name>`); unattended, proceed from tool schemas and
flag the gap.

**REQUIRED BACKGROUND:** scenario-roblox-expert (channels, review loop, toolkit, current-Roblox
traps).

**Status (2026-10-19):** 14 live tests pass in Studio 0.743; 8 offline checks pass (18 Lune unit
tests, luau-lsp on both type solvers over code, fixtures and snippets, StyLua, selene).

## Stance (the expert delta)

1. **Pin placement and RunContext: one entry Script per side.** Use one Script with RunContext
   Server in ServerScriptService and one with RunContext Client in ReplicatedStorage (Roblox docs,
   Script locations; Ludius, n8IDTRW1EfM [00:01:34]; Leif, F3ASTJuO82A [00:03:18]). Everything else
   is a ModuleScript.
   - A Client Script in StarterPlayerScripts ran twice (live), with a "non-legacy RunContext"
     warning in Output.
   - Rojo 7.7.1 turns `.client.luau` into a LocalScript unless the project sets
     `"emitLegacyScripts": false` (verified). A LocalScript in ReplicatedStorage never runs.
2. **Boot in two phases through one loader.** GetDescendants order is undefined, so no module may
   call another while loading (Suphi Kaner, YsXijBUUmmM [00:04:22]). Init sets up its own state and
   never yields; Start may yield and call others (Leif [00:02:25]; docs, `start()` on every module).
   [`Loader.luau`](scripts/agentkit/architecture/Loader.luau) adds what the sources skip [added]:
   - an explicit order, then the rest sorted by path; duplicate names fail (Suphi [00:01:50]);
   - one pcall per module, so one broken service does not stop the others;
   - an Init that yields is reported as an error;
   - a frozen registry and a boot report written as attributes.
3. **Server modules own the truth; attributes mirror it; UI owns nothing.** A state service never
   requires its GUI; the GUI calls the service and listens (MrAsync [00:25:46 to 00:31:11]). Publish
   shared state as attributes on a Configuration that clients observe (Crusherfire, 6Q_p2ObUXSo
   [00:07:06]). Mirror absolute server times (`EndsAt`) so clients count down without a timer remote
   [added]. A property or attribute change and a remote are not ordered relative to each other
   (docs, Attributes; Server Authority): put the state in the remote payload, or publish it only as
   attributes and re-render on each change.
4. **Bind behavior by tag, filtered by ancestor.** One module drives every tagged instance instead
   of a script per instance (B Ricey, Vi2FckNJv9w [00:02:44]; GnomeCode, UsPYgIW3rv8 [00:01:38];
   docs). Two traps the sources miss [added]:
   - A tagged template in ServerStorage is in GetTagged too: bind only under chosen ancestors.
   - Moving a tagged part from ServerStorage back to Workspace fired no InstanceAdded (live): watch
     AncestryChanged.

   [`Binder.luau`](scripts/agentkit/architecture/Binder.luau) does both, connects the signals before
   GetTagged, and runs the cleanup that setup returns.

5. **Every connection has an owner with a lifetime.** Wire cleanup to the owner that dies with it,
   for example a per-tycoon Trove instead of the player's (Crusherfire, 0moy04A9vFg [00:16:38]). Add
   to the cleanup object at creation (B Ricey, 2Msrw5w5cTs [00:09:27]). Set
   Workspace.PlayerCharacterDestroyBehavior to Enabled (Crusherfire, YWyJHwynM1M [00:12:34]). Under
   Deferred signals a Destroying handler runs after the destroy (Crusherfire, xz_G2n1Q8-U
   [00:12:45]). Live, the handler had not run before the yield and then read Parent nil: capture
   state before removal; removal handlers only clear tables. A listener connected inside another
   handler misses the fire already queued, and nested fires run breadth-first (Crusherfire [00:03:19
   to 00:08:52]; live): connect every listener in Init.
   - Screens have a lifetime too: each spawn recopies StarterGui into PlayerGui, except direct
     children with ResetOnSpawn false; a Folder cancels false (docs, On-screen UI containers).
     Players die every round, so the HUD and shop use false (GnomeCode, oEWoyT-GBZY [00:14:38]) and
     their run-once controllers keep valid references (live).
6. **Server code and round content never sit in a replicated container.** Exploiters can read
   ReplicatedStorage (Leif [00:01:00]; Crusherfire, 6Q_p2ObUXSo [00:09:13]). Maps stay in
   ServerStorage until needed, which cuts join traffic (docs, Data model). Clone one into Workspace
   per round and destroy it after (GnomeCode [00:11:03 to 00:13:51], who keeps them in
   ReplicatedStorage). Crusherfire relocates server modules from a system folder to
   ServerScriptService at start (6Q_p2ObUXSo [00:09:47]). Require siblings by relative path so a
   system can move (Crusherfire [00:23:46]).
7. **The client asks; remotes are made in code.** Never create remotes by hand in Explorer (Leif,
   F3ASTJuO82A [00:04:28]). The client asks "can I build here?" and the server decides (Leif
   [00:05:39]). Check on the client to save bandwidth and again on the server (MrAsync [00:16:37]).
8. **Pick the framework by team, not taste.** Knit-style frameworks decide for you, and everything
   depends on one service (B Ricey, MyK4o2pIpQw [00:17:58]); the 2025 sources build small loaders
   (Ludius, Leif, Crusherfire). Solo or small team: this loader, Signal and a cleanup module; an
   existing Knit codebase: keep it and add the audit [added]. A class only for several stateful
   instances (B Ricey [00:07:10]); a service is a singleton table (Leif [00:02:00]).

## Establish first

- Session shape: round-based, persistent world or hub; player count; teams.
- New place or existing code: Rojo or Script Sync repository, Studio-only, or an existing framework
  to keep.
- Team size and whether systems are shared across places (Roblox Packages for your own systems,
  Wally for third-party code).
- Server Authority (`AuthorityMode = Server`): it forces Deferred signals and replicates only the
  first 64 attributes per instance.
- StreamingEnabled, on in new places (these tests ran with it off): clients wait for streamed parts.

Defaults: Rojo project with `emitLegacyScripts` false, the arena skeleton below, Deferred signals,
PlayerCharacterDestroyBehavior Enabled, `--!strict`.

## Procedure

Setup: `import rbx_architecture as A` (it puts the lead's scripts on `sys.path`). Full code and
recorded results are in [`references/procedures.md`](references/procedures.md).

1. **Scaffold.** `A.scaffold(dest, name, fixtures=False)` copies the arena skeleton plus Loader and
   Binder, writes the Rojo project and builds the place through `rbx_env.new_place`. **GATE:**
   `A.place_facts(place)` shows Server and Client RunContexts, SignalBehavior Deferred and
   PlayerCharacterDestroyBehavior Enabled; `A.check(dest)` returns 0 errors on both type solvers.
2. **Map the modules.** Write the module map before code. Dependencies point from services to shared
   modules, never from a service to UI or from replicated code to the server.

   | Module                          | Side   | Owns                                                         |
   | ------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
   | PlayerService                   | server | per-player and per-character tables, cleared on leave        |
   | TeamService                     | server | team assignment and alive teams                              |
   | RoundService                    | server | the RoundMachine state, `StateChanged`, the GameState mirror |
   | WeaponService                   | server | swords by tag: give, take, re-give on respawn                |
   | MapService                      | server | one map clone per round, rotation, pads, hazards by tag      |
   | DamageService, ShopService      | server | handed to scenario-roblox-gameplay and scenario-roblox-data  |
   | RoundMachine, Config, Signal    | shared | pure logic, constants, signals (run in Lune)                 |
   | RoundController, ShopController | client | HUD and shop, wired once, ResetOnSpawn false                 |

   **GATE:** `A.audit_file(place)` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings, no require cycle and 0
   unresolved requires.

3. **Boot.** Each entry script calls
   `Loader.boot(Loader.ordered(folder, order), {publish = script})`. **GATE:** in a playtest,
   `A.boot_report(pt)` shows BootOk true, BootErrors 0 and BootCount 1 on both sides, with every
   `init:` before every `start:`. The console has no "required recursively" and no `[Loader]` line.
4. **State and mirrors.** RoundService writes `EndsAt`, `Winner`, then `RoundState`; controllers
   re-render on every attribute change. `Test_*` attributes on GameState shorten the loop in Studio
   only. **GATE:** server state, client mirror and HUD text agree; capture the HUD, run
   `image_checks` and open the image.
5. **Tags and lifetimes.** Bind tagged instances with `Binder.bind(tag, setup, {ancestors = ...})`.
   Clear player tables on PlayerRemoving and character tables on CharacterRemoving. Re-give round
   items on CharacterAdded, because a respawn empties the Backpack. MapService clones the map at
   Intermission and destroys it on the way to Lobby. **GATE:** five respawns mid-round leave one
   tracked character and one bound sword on the map. After a respawn, the HUD and shop are the same
   instances. In Lobby, Workspace holds 0 maps and 0 bound hazards, the instance count is back
   within 10, and frames meet the gate across a map load.
6. **Observe and iterate live.** Open the place once with `rbx_env.open_place` inside
   `rbx_env.place_slot()`. After each edit, push sources with `A.sync_sources(studio, dest)` instead
   of reopening. **GATE:** `A.run(s, "return ArchAudit.all(game)", kit=["ArchAudit"])` matches the
   offline tally, and `tests/code/scenario-roblox-architecture/run_live.py` exits 0.

## Numbers

| Value                                        | Number                                                                                            | Relative to                                             |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Player latency                               | 100 to 300 ms                                                                                     | docs, Client-server runtime                             |
| Studio playtest latency                      | 0 ms; simulate 50 to 150 ms each way                                                              | docs; Studio Settings, Network, or `settings().Network` |
| Module size smell                            | 500+ lines                                                                                        | MrAsync [00:20:54]; ArchAudit `module-size`             |
| Replicated attributes under Server Authority | first 64 per instance; names and strings up to 50 characters                                      | docs, Server Authority                                  |
| Boot, measured                               | server 5 services 1.56 to 2.52 ms; client 2 controllers 0.40 to 1.08 ms                           | live, Studio 0.743                                      |
| Client order, measured                       | ReplicatedFirst ran 35 to 36 ms before client Main; `IsLoaded` false, then true; no character yet | live                                                    |
| Five respawns mid-round                      | instances +3 or -3 (about 46,150); 1 character, 1 bound sword                                     | live, 6 runs                                            |
| Arena defaults                               | 2 players, 15 s intermission, 120 s round, 5 s ending, 0.25 s tick                                | [added]                                                 |
| Frame gate                                   | p95 at most 20 ms, worst at most 33.3 ms at 60 fps (1.2 x and 2 x the budget)                     | scenario-roblox-expert                                  |
| Map cycle, measured                          | Server p95 17.3 ms, worst 17.5 to 20.0 ms across a clone; Lobby instance delta 0                  | live, 3 runs                                            |

## Quality gates

- **Measurable:**
  - ArchAudit: 0 errors and 0 warnings outside fixtures; AgentKit `Audit.all(game)` has 0 errors.
  - Boot report on both sides: BootOk, BootErrors 0, BootCount 1.
  - Console: no "required recursively", "not a valid member", `[Loader]` or "non-legacy RunContext"
    lines.
  - Lifetimes: `Characters` equals the player count after respawns; in Lobby, 0 maps and 0 bound
    hazards, and the instance count is back within 10; Server and Client frames meet the gate.
  - `run_live.py` exits 0; the Lune unit tests pass; luau-lsp has 0 errors on both solvers
    (`A.check`); StyLua and selene are clean.
- **Visual:** a capture during a round shows the HUD with the mirrored state; `image_checks` raises
  no flag and you open the image. A human reviewer gets an Explorer capture.

## Common mistakes

| Mistake                                                                | Symptom                                      | Fix                                                                                      |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Client Script in StarterPlayerScripts                                  | runs twice; Studio warns in Output           | move the entry Script to ReplicatedStorage, or use a LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts |
| Rojo default `emitLegacyScripts`                                       | client entry in ReplicatedStorage never runs | set `"emitLegacyScripts": false`                                                         |
| `require` of a live service from `execute_luau`                        | fresh copy: fields nil, state empty          | read the module's Studio-only attributes                                                 |
| Tagged template in ServerStorage                                       | template gets behavior                       | `ancestors` filter                                                                       |
| Reparent within the DataModel                                          | behavior missing after moving back           | AncestryChanged watch (Binder)                                                           |
| Round items given once                                                 | sword gone after respawn                     | re-give on CharacterAdded during the round                                               |
| Reading Parent in Destroying or CharacterRemoving                      | nil under Deferred                           | capture state before destroy                                                             |
| Listener connected inside a handler                                    | misses the fire already queued               | connect in Init, before anything fires                                                   |
| `SetAttribute`, then `FireAllClients`; the handler reads the attribute | can read the old value on live servers       | send the state in the payload                                                            |
| Maps in ReplicatedStorage or Workspace                                 | every client downloads every map at join     | ServerStorage, one clone per round (`maps-replicated`)                                   |
| Run-once controller holding a ScreenGui with ResetOnSpawn true         | HUD gone after the first death               | ResetOnSpawn false                                                                       |
| ResetOnSpawn false on a ScreenGui inside a Folder                      | rebuilt at every respawn anyway              | direct child of StarterGui (`reset-ignored-nested`)                                      |
| `_G` registry, duplicate module names                                  | silent overwrite                             | Loader registry; `ordered` errors on duplicates                                          |
| Package with AutoUpdate off                                            | copies never update                          | AutoUpdate on (Roblox Learn, AzKZy2BqIh8 [00:09:55])                                     |

## Handoffs

- **Receives from:** scenario-roblox-expert (brief, toolkit, place slot); scenario-3d and
  scenario-game-assets (models that arrive as tagged templates in ServerStorage).
- **Delivers to:** scenario-roblox-networking (service layout, remote module slot),
  scenario-roblox-data (DataService boot slot, PlayerRemoving hooks), scenario-roblox-gameplay (hits
  and damage inside Binder setups), scenario-roblox-ui (controllers on GameState, the shop screen),
  scenario-roblox-luau (types, Signal, deferred events), scenario-roblox-tooling (Rojo project, CI),
  scenario-roblox-performance (leaks, streaming), scenario-roblox-animation (character scripts).
- **Form:** the Rojo `src/` tree, the module map, the ArchAudit report and `results.json`.

## Current Roblox notes

- Rojo 7.7.1 drops `"Position"` on a Part with exit 0 and leaves it at the origin: write a 12-number
  `"CFrame"` (verified).
- Rojo 7.7.1 builds Script Sync's `.local.luau` and `.legacy.luau` as ModuleScripts named `X.local`
  and `X.legacy` (verified): do not mix the two suffix schemes.
- require-by-string: `./`, `../`, `@self` and `@game`; special handling of `Init` modules is gone
  (version deltas row 23).
- SignalBehavior: new templates and Server Authority use Deferred; `Default` still maps to Immediate
  in older places. `workspace.SignalBehavior` failed with "not a valid member" from `execute_luau`
  (live): read it in Properties or from the file with Lune.
- PlayerCharacterDestroyBehavior is NotScriptable: set it in Properties or in the Rojo project.
- `CollectionService:CreateCollection` is documented, but in Studio 0.743 it errored "Collections
  are not enabled" (live). Use tags and Binder.
- Next Gen Studio UI is the default: menu paths in
  [`references/gui-paths.md`](references/gui-paths.md).
- Creator Store assets cannot `require(assetId)`: vendor the code.

## References

- [`references/expert-notes.md`](references/expert-notes.md): principles by expert with timestamps,
  and live corrections.
- [`references/procedures.md`](references/procedures.md): every procedure with full code, its test
  and the recorded result.
- [`references/critique.md`](references/critique.md): the self-review rubric.
- [`references/project-setup.md`](references/project-setup.md): client start, StreamingEnabled,
  Packages and team tools, two-client tests.
- [`references/gui-paths.md`](references/gui-paths.md): Studio menus and panels for the same steps.
- [`references/sources.md`](references/sources.md): every source with URL and best timestamps.
- [`scripts/rbx_architecture.py`](scripts/rbx_architecture.py): scaffold, audit, place facts, sync,
  boot report.
- [`scripts/agentkit/architecture/`](scripts/agentkit/architecture/): Loader, Binder, ArchAudit and
  the Lune runners.
- [`scripts/templates/arena/`](scripts/templates/arena/): the tested arena core and its audit
  fixtures.

# Roblox Asset Pipeline and UGC

Target: Roblox Studio (October 2026 build) on macOS, driven through the scenario-roblox-expert
toolkit.

Expert level here means every mesh arrives in Studio already at its size in studs, facing -Z, under
its triangle budget, closed when it must be, with maps sized and split for Roblox, and with numbers
that prove it. Fix in Blender, preview and audit in Studio without uploading, validate locally to
green, and stop exactly where Roblox needs an uploaded asset.

If a sibling skill named here is missing from your available skills, ask the user to install it
(`npx skills add scenario-labs/skills --skill <name>`); unattended, proceed from tool schemas and
flag the gap.

**REQUIRED BACKGROUND:** scenario-roblox-expert (channels, review loop, toolkit, current-Roblox
traps).

## Stance (the expert delta)

1. **Treat an AI GLB as raw input with known defects.** Image-to-3D output arrives about 0.95 units
   across, front facing +Z, every material `doubleSided`, `metallicFactor` 1.0 with painted partial
   metalness, 2048 px JPEG maps and pinholes [added, measured on two generator outputs]. Raw meshes
   need remesh, pivot and scale work (CallMeDogey).
2. **Decide size in studs in Blender, not in Studio.** One Blender unit is one stud; glTF then needs
   no Importer scale (Creator Docs, Importer; KatsBits [00:02:56]). Props pivot at the bottom center
   (Common Sense Machines [00:02:39]); accessories at the mesh center (validation #173).
3. **Turn the front to -Z before export.** glTF fronts face +Z; Roblox's LookVector is -Z. A 180
   degree yaw in Blender fixes it for good [added].
4. **An accessory is its bounding box, and a hat is its crown.** Bounds are per AccessoryType,
   measured around the attachment, and rotation grows the box (KatsBits [00:10:34]). The box follows
   `AvatarPartScaleType`: none or Classic gives the `GetValidationRules()` box (Hat 3 x 4 x 3),
   ProportionsNormal the docs row (1.87 x 2.5 x 1.87) [added, live]. Scale a hat so its crown clears
   the head, then check the box: filled to the Normal box by its brim, the test hat's crown was
   narrower than the default head [added].
5. **Measure watertightness; do not trust a fill operator.** `bmesh.ops.holes_fill` capped 2 of 9
   pinholes on the test hat, and decimation then created edges with three faces [added]. Cap each
   loop, repair after decimation, count boundary edges again. Never use Make Double Sided to hide
   holes (Creator Docs, Importer).
6. **Preview without uploading.** EditableMesh plus EditableImage rebuild the prepared mesh and its
   PBR maps in the place for audits, wear tests and captures [added]. That content is session-only
   and empty in a playtest copy [added]; ship through the Importer with Upload to Roblox off while
   iterating (Creator Docs; Templates [00:02:31]).
7. **Validate locally to green, then stop.** `ValidateUGCAccessoryAsync` runs Roblox's validator
   inside a playtest. Fix every string about geometry, schema, materials or bounds; ownership and
   moderation strings need an uploaded asset and end the agent's part (Creator Docs, validation
   system).
8. **Textures follow density, not the source.** 256 px per 2 x 2 x 2 studs, power of two; OpenGL
   normals; metalness 0 or 1 unless satin by design; opaque ColorMap on accessories (Creator Docs,
   texture specifications and SurfaceAppearance).

## Establish first

- Destination: in-experience prop, or Marketplace avatar item. Only the second must pass validation
  and be watertight.
- Size in studs per asset (an R15 character is about 5 to 6 studs tall), and for accessories the
  AccessoryType and the `AvatarPartScaleType` it will declare (Classic, ProportionsNormal,
  ProportionsSlender).
- Budget class: hero prop, clutter, or accessory (4,000 triangles).
- Source: GLB from scenario-3d (preferred), FBX (needs FBX Unit Scale), or OBJ (mesh only).
- Rigged or skinned input goes to scenario-roblox-animation after import.
- Defaults when unanswered: prop, bottom pivot, longest side from the concept's scale, texture side
  from `texture_side`, hat crown opening 1.35 studs, no scale type (Classic box).

## Procedure

Full code and recorded results: [procedures.md](references/procedures.md). Setup:
`import rbx_assets as ra` (it finds the lead toolkit). Every snippet ran in Studio 0.743 or Blender
5.2 on 2026-10-19, except those marked not yet run; Edit and playtest captures confirmed the fit (a
covered window returns dark frames: judge on numbers then).

1. **Triage.** Goal: know the defects. How: `ra.glb_info(path)` offline. GATE: triangles, size, map
   sizes, `doubleSided`, skins and extensions written down per asset.
2. **Fix in Blender.** Goal: size, facing, pivot, budget, closed mesh, Roblox maps. How:
   `ra.blender_prep({**ra.PROP_PREP or ra.ACCESSORY_PREP, "input", "out_dir", "yaw": 180, "scale": ...})`,
   with `{"opening": 1.35, "band": [0.08, 0.2], "cap": [3, 4, 3]}` for hats; it waits for the
   machine guard, runs `blender -b`, writes a report and four Workbench views. GATE:
   `ra.gates(report["after"], kind, type)` all pass, and the front view shows the front.
3. **Read live rules.** Goal: today's limits. How:
   `ra.run(studio, "return AssetAudit.rules()", kit=["AssetAudit"])`. GATE: `AccessoryMaxTriangles`,
   `MaxTextureSize` and the type's attachment `Size` and `Offset` recorded; the offline gates use
   them.
4. **Preview and audit in Studio.** Goal: the asset in the place, measured. How: `ra.stage` the
   packed mesh and maps, then `MeshBuild.build` and `AssetAudit.prop`. GATE: `Size` equals the
   Blender size within 0.01 stud, the triangle count matches, no audit error, the front capture
   shows the front.
5. **Build the accessory.** Goal: Accessory, Handle, one attachment named for the type. How:
   `MeshBuild.accessory`, then `AssetAudit.accessory(acc, rules)`. GATE: zero errors;
   `AvatarPartScaleType` is the only warning (the Accessory Fitting Tool adds it).
6. **Wear test.** Goal: it sits right. How: `UGCCheck.rig` and `UGCCheck.wear` in Edit, then
   captures front and side. GATE: a joint exists, attachment error under 0.01 stud, `opening.clears`
   (crown at least head-wide at the head top), and the brim rests on the head in the captures.
7. **Validate locally.** Goal: only upload-bound strings left. How: in a `Playtest`,
   `ra.stage(..., dm="Server")` and `UGCCheck.validate(acc, Enum.AccessoryType.Hat)`; run
   single-fault copies as negative controls, at most 10 calls per 60 seconds. GATE: the item returns
   valid with no string; every fault copy fails.
8. **Hand off the import.** Goal: the shipping path. How: the human or a computer-use agent imports
   `<name>_roblox.glb` with the settings in [gui-paths.md](references/gui-paths.md); the Accessory
   Fitting Tool generates the final accessory. GATE: the imported MeshPart's Size equals the
   preview's; P7 audits it again.

## Numbers

| 4,000 triangles                   | Rigid or layered accessory                                                            | Creator Docs; live `AccessoryMaxTriangles`         |
| 60,000 vertices, 20,000 triangles | One EditableMesh; a quad counts as 2                                                  | EditableMesh reference                             |
| 256 px per 2 x 2 x 2 studs        | Texture side, next power of two                                                       | Texture specifications                             |
| 4096 px                           | Place textures (since 2026-01-30)                                                     | DevForum                                           |
| 1024 px                           | Avatar ColorMap, live `MaxTextureSize`; other avatar maps 256                         | Validation system; live                            |
| 1024 px                           | EditableImage side                                                                    | AssetService reference                             |
| Hat 3 x 4 x 3 studs               | No `AvatarPartScaleType` or Classic; ProportionsNormal 1.87 x 2.5 x 1.87              | Live rules and validator; accessory specifications |
| 10 pieces                         | Disconnected components per accessory MeshPart                                        | Validation #187                                    |

| 0 to 40                           | `EmissiveStrength` on Marketplace items                                               | SurfaceAppearance                                  |

| 10 calls per 60 s                 | `ValidateUGCAccessoryAsync` rate limit                                                | Live error string                                  |

## Quality gates

Measurable:

- Blender report: every `ra.gates` entry passes; the raw input fails what it should (negative
  control).
- Studio: `AssetAudit` returns no error; `Size` and triangle count equal the report.
- Wear: joint present, attachment error under 0.01 stud.
- Validator: no string left that is fixable without an upload.

Visual (one contact sheet, 1,600 px at most, opened and read):

- Front of each asset faces the camera from -Z; props stand on the ground; nothing black or inside
  out.
- The hat sits on the head from the front and the side, neither floating nor sunk past the brim.
- Textures read like the concept: details in place, no smeared atlas.

Score the result with [critique.md](references/critique.md) before calling it done.

## Common mistakes

| Mistake                                                        | Symptom                                           | Fix                                                                                                                            |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Importing the unit-sized GLB as is                             | Prop the size of a brick                          | Scale in Blender to studs; Scale Unit Studs                                                                                    |
| No yaw on glTF input                                           | Lock or face on the back side                     | `yaw: 180` before export                                                                                                       |
| Make Double Sided to hide holes                                | Validation boundary-edge error; double triangles  | Close holes in Blender                                                                                                         |
| Trusting `holes_fill`                                          | "Not watertight" after the fix                    | Cap loops, repair after decimation, recount                                                                                    |
| Decimating in Studio's head                                    | Over 4,000 triangles at upload                    | Decimate in Blender to 3,800                                                                                                   |
| Packed metallic-roughness used as one map                      | Metal everywhere or nowhere                       | Split G and B to grayscale maps                                                                                                |
| Partial metalness kept                                         | Tinted, plastic-looking metal                     | Snap to 0 or 1 after reading the mask                                                                                          |
| ColorMap with alpha on an accessory                            | Validation #145, see-through spots                | `opaque_color`                                                                                                                 |
| TextureID and SurfaceAppearance both set                       | Validation #146                                   | One of them                                                                                                                    |
| Attributes or tags left on the accessory                       | Validation #191                                   | Strip before validating                                                                                                        |
| Pivot at the feet for an accessory                             | "Mesh data is not centered"                       | Center pivot                                                                                                                   |
| Rotating the hat inside the fitting box                        | Box red although the mesh looks inside            | Re-center and orient in Blender                                                                                                |
| Sizing a hat by its brim                                       | Head pokes through the crown                      | `scale.opening`, then `opening.clears`                                                                                         |
| `Massless` true on the Handle                                  | Validator: "Expected to be = false"               | Leave the default                                                                                                              |
| `AddAccessory` from the client on your own character           | No joint; the hat falls                           | Attach on the server; seat a local preview by CFrame                                                                           |
| Hat mesh and texture built from Editable content on the server | Clients draw a small checkered cube at the Handle | Keep the joint on the server; on each client, apply a locally built mesh (`ApplyMesh`) and `SurfaceAppearance` (procedures P8) |
| Expecting an EditableMesh preview to save                      | Part empty after reopening                        | Session only; import for real                                                                                                  |
| Expecting the Edit preview in a playtest                       | Copied parts keep Size but have no mesh           | Stage and build in that data model                                                                                             |

## Handoffs

- Receives from scenario-3d: GLB or FBX meshes with PBR maps (image-to-3D, remesh, retexture,
  rigging). Ask for a remesh run when decimation damages the silhouette.
- Receives from scenario-textures: PBR sets for one mesh, which become SurfaceAppearance here.
  Tileable sets go to scenario-roblox-environment as MaterialVariants.
- Receives from scenario-game-assets: the concept image that scenario-3d turns into a mesh (one
  centered subject, plain background, front view). Icons, sprites and UI art go to
  scenario-roblox-ui, decals to scenario-roblox-environment.
- Delivers to scenario-roblox-environment: MeshParts at true size with a bottom pivot, a proposed
  CollisionFidelity and the gate report; it places, sets final fidelity and LevelOfDetail, and
  lights.
- Delivers to scenario-roblox-animation: rigged or skinned imports, checked for scale and facing.
- Delivers to scenario-roblox-performance: each import batch, for its memory and batching audit
  (`references/memory-and-crowds.md`, `PerfAudit.assets`), which this skill does not repeat.

## Current Roblox notes

- `EditableMesh` and `EditableImage` are not creatable with `Instance.new`; use
  `AssetService:CreateEditableMesh()`, `CreateEditableImage()` and `Content.fromObject`. Published
  experiences need the Mesh and Image APIs setting.
- `CreateSurfaceAppearanceAsync` takes EditableImage content only; maps cannot be swapped afterward.
- The Avatar Joint Upgrade joins rigid accessories with `RigidConstraint`, not a weld. Find
  attachments with `FindFirstChild(name, true)`.
- `GenerateMeshAsync` is scheduled for deprecation; `GenerationService:GenerateModelAsync` with
  schema `Car5` or `Body1` replaces it.
- Places take 4096 px textures since 2026-01-30; avatar limits come from `GetValidationRules()`.
- Studio MCP runs with plugin rights: in Edit it wrote `SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap`,
  `ColorMapContent` and `MeshPart.CollisionFidelity` without error. Game scripts have fewer rights;
  test a snippet in a Script before shipping it in one.
- `generate_mesh` (Studio MCP) returns only `{generationName, tag}` and inserts a Model of segmented
  MeshParts with asset IDs and a TextureID; pass `size`, `maxTriangles` and `segmentation`.
